description: Implementation of the starboard application class managing application lifecycle events, event dispatching, and state transitions.

classes.name: Application
classes.description: Manages application lifecycle, event dispatching, and state transitions within the starboard platform.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Initializes and runs the application with command line arguments and optional link data.

methods.name: RunLoop
methods.description: Main event loop processing events until termination.

methods.name: DispatchAndDelete
methods.description: Dispatches an event and manages its lifecycle, handling state transitions.

methods.name: HandleEventAndUpdateState
methods.description: Processes an event, updates application state, and calls platform-specific event handler.

methods.name: CreateInitialEvent
methods.description: Creates initial preload or start events with command line arguments.

methods.name: SetStartLink
methods.description: Sets the start link data for the application.
